text:
Nora Li: Dropped a small set of tweaks for the RBAC screen + invite flow. Need quick takes on copy, SSO hint placement, and keyboard behavior.
Ben Ortega: Saw them. My biggest worry is the condensed roles table hiding critical perms. Suggest showing a "5 perms" pill that expands inline.
Rin Okamoto: Agreed. For accessibility make that pill focusable and announce expanded content via aria-live. Also table cells should be reachable with arrow keys.
Sam (design): Copy nit: current invite drawer header says "Add people"; product prefers "Invite members to organization". Short hint under SSO toggle: "SSO required to sign in".
Nora Li: Where should the SSO hint live? Inline near role selector or as a top banner when theres a domain mismatch?
Ben Ortega: Banner when domain mismatch, small inline label when SSO simply enabled. Banner should be dismissible and use aria-live polite for screen readers.
Rin Okamoto: Backend will flag preview payload with sso_enabled and domain_match. Frontend rule: if sso_enabled && !domain_match -> banner. Also return duplicate_emails and invalid_emails arrays for immediate validation.
Sam (design): For the audit log, add quick filters (action, user, timeframe) and a sticky header. On mobile collapse filters into a single dropdown.
Nora Li: Dev notes: make sure the SSO switch uses role="switch" and aria-checked. Also implement keyboard shortcut (g then i) to open invite drawer and document it.
access-bot: build-preview/rbac-invite-ux ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/rbac-invite-ux (48h)
Ben Ortega: One more: tooltip strings should be short fragments, e.g., "Manage API keys". Avoid long sentences.
Sam (design): Will update mocks and include a11y overlay showing focus states. Back with updates by EOD. :shipit:
